name: Kit (ConvertKit)
notes: Email/creator-monetization platform; founder Nathan Barry has repeatedly stated no VC ever raised (yaro.blog interview). Company-disclosed revenue ~$43M/yr, but no public customer count to split into customers x arpu -- inputs left blank rather than guessed, so the model shows no estimate despite clearly qualifying.

name: Buffer
notes: Social media management platform; took small early seed/Series A money but spent $3.3M buying out ALL outside investors (buffer.com/resources/buying-out-investors), now effectively employee-owned. customers=67,000 paying customers and arpu=$339 both derived from company-reported ~$22.7M ARR / 67,000 customers (2025).

name: Gumroad
notes: Creator storefront/e-commerce platform; founder Sahil Lavingia has publicly described buying back investor equity and paying a $5.34M shareholder dividend (sahillavingia.com/dividends). HOWEVER this tool's own Form D check found Gumroad, Inc. (CIK 1532978) filed a real equity Form D as recently as 2024-03-04 ($2,136,975 offering, fully sold) and 2023-06-16 -- so despite the earlier buyback narrative, Gumroad has taken on new private capital since. Treat as flagged, not bootstrapped, pending further diligence. Q2 2023 revenue $5.29M/quarter, ~$23.8M est. ARR (2024) -- no public seller/customer count to split into customers x arpu, left blank rather than guessed.

name: Ghost
notes: Open-source publishing/newsletter platform (404 Media, Platformer run on it); run by the nonprofit Ghost Foundation, funded by a 2013 Kickstarter after 2x YC rejection, no VC. Founder stated on X it crossed $10M ARR as a bootstrapped nonprofit -- no public customer count to split into customers x arpu, left blank rather than guessed.

name: Flodesk
notes: Email marketing/checkout platform for creators; founders rejected by YC, self-funded with ~$90k savings (Inc.com). customers=100,000+ paying customers (company-reported) and arpu=$270 derived from a conservative ~$27M ARR estimate (2024, IndieHackers) / 100,000 customers.

name: Patreon
notes: Known VC-backed control case (Form D on file, CIK 1860300) -- included to validate the funding flag, not as a bootstrapped candidate. No financial inputs supplied on purpose.
